mapper.sql: auto_id, node_inst_id, proc_inst_id, node_def_id, name, type, parent_id, status, error_policy, shard_enabled, shard_resolver, condition_expr, config, result, creator_id, updator_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ${orch.table.nodeInst}(node_inst_id, proc_inst_id, node_def_id, name, type, parent_id, status, error_policy, shard_enabled, shard_resolver, condition_expr, config, creator_id, updator_id) VALUES(#{nodeInstId}, #{procInstId}, #{nodeDefId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{status}, #{errorPolicy}, #{shardEnabled}, #{shardResolver}, #{conditionExpr}, #{config}, #{creatorId}, #{updatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ${orch.table.nodeInst} n JOIN ${orch.table.processInst} p ON p.proc_inst_id = n.proc_inst_id SET n.status = 'running' WHERE n.node_inst_id = #{id} AND n.status = 'pending' AND p.status = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT n.node_inst_id FROM ${orch.table.nodeInst} n JOIN ${orch.table.processInst} p ON p.proc_inst_id = n.proc_inst_id WHERE n.status = 'pending' AND p.status = 'running' ORDER BY n.auto_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
